subject: Pricing and eligibility: LaunchPad Student Incubator — hosted API rates
messages:
From: Aaron Patel <aaron@launchpad.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry — hosted API baseline + education/startup discounts

Hi Jordan,

We run the LaunchPad Student Incubator (nonprofit-registered, US-based) and are evaluating hosted API options for a pilot this fall. Our primary ask: what baseline rates and documented eligibility paths does Redwood offer for education/nonprofit programs and early-stage startup partners?

Quick background: we support ~30 university teams with an application that does resume parsing, short answer grading, and chatbot Q&A. We expect steady growth from ~10M tokens/mo in month 1 to ~60–80M tokens/mo by month 6 if the pilot expands.

Specific questions:
- Do you have a standard education / nonprofit discount and what proof do you need?
- Are there startup credits or pilot credits for incubators?
- Can we request a temporary rate exception if volume ramps faster than expected?
- Any constraints on dataset retention or private deployment for student data?

I attached a one-page usage estimate and our nonprofit registration. Would love a short call next week.

Thanks,
Aaron
Program Director
LaunchPad Student Incubator
attachments: launchpad_usage_estimate.xlsx, proof_of_nonprofit.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Patel <aaron@launchpad.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry — hosted API baseline + education/startup discounts

Hi Aaron — thanks for the note and the attachments, they came through.

Short answer: yes, we have both an education/nonprofit pathway and pilot credits for early-stage programs. The eligibility rules differ depending on whether you want ongoing discounted pricing or a time-limited pilot credit. To make this concrete, could you confirm:
- Are you an IRS 501(c)(3) (or equivalent) or fiscally sponsored?
- Is the pilot strictly for student-facing educational activities (vs commercial redistribution)?
- Do you expect to store logs or use Private deployment features?

I'll loop in Neha from Sales Ops for contract & eligibility details and Ben (our EDU vertical lead) for workload sizing recommendations. If you're available next Tue/Wed afternoon PT I can book 30 mins.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Education & Startups
Redwood Inference
From: Aaron Patel <aaron@launchpad.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elisabeth Nguyen <elisabeth@bridgeu.org>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry — hosted API baseline + education/startup discounts

Thanks Jordan — answers below:
- We are incorporated as a nonprofit and listed as 501(c)(3) in our paperwork (proof attached). We are not fiscally sponsored.
- The pilot is student-facing: resume parsing, short-form grading, chatbot; no resale.
- We plan to keep logs for 30 days for quality monitoring. We do not need Private deployment for the pilot, but may request it if we move to a production contract with PII retention constraints.

We can do Tue 23 Jun at 2pm PT — Aaron + our operations lead (procure@launchpad.ai).

Thanks,
Aaron
attachments: proof_of_nonprofit.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Patel <aaron@launchpad.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry — hosted API baseline + education/startup discounts

Hi Aaron — thanks for confirming and for the doc. I pulled the initial numbers and wrote up two options you can evaluate. Sharing the short summary here; I attached our EDU discount criteria doc as well.

Option A — Education Pilot (recommended for initial 6 months)
- 40% off hosted API list rates for generation tokens (applies to first 6 months from pilot start).
- Up to 75M tokens total across the pilot period; overage billed at 60% of list.
- Requires proof of nonprofit status + letter describing student-facing scope.
- No Private deployment included; logs retained up to 30 days.

Option B — Startup-Incubator Sponsor (higher ramp)
- $10k pilot credit + volume discounts if you commit to a minimum monthly spend of $3k after month 3.
- If volume reaches >50M tokens/month by month 3, we can evaluate an exception to the standard overage rate and propose a blended unit price (internal approval required).

Notes / caveats
- Any formal rate exceptions above the standard pilot require sign-off from Revenue Ops (usually 1–2 business days once we have a usage forecast).
- For student data with PII we recommend Private deployment and a short security review; that is available as an add-on.

Next steps: please confirm which option you prefer and share a 3-month rolling forecast (tokens/month). I can draft a short pilot MSA and a mutual action plan to capture milestones (kickoff, mid-pilot check, production decision).

Attachments: edu-discount-criteria.pdf

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Aaron Patel <aaron@launchpad.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@launchpad.ai, Elisabeth Nguyen <elisabeth@bridgeu.org>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry — hosted API baseline + education/startup discounts

Thanks Neha — that is really helpful and clear. We'd like to proceed with Option A plus request one small exception: if our monthly tokens exceed 50M by month 3, we request a blended overage cap not exceeding 50% of list for that month (we can provide detailed logs).

We will:
- Send a 3-month forecast by EOD Monday.
- Review and sign the pilot MSA.
- Upload the nonprofit proof to the secure link you provide.

Could you send a short mutual action plan and the pilot MSA for signatures? Also looping in our procurement address.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get started.

Aaron
Program Director
LaunchPad Student Incubator
attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx
